g.text: Label each vial with its position + ID (for example, A1 / L01). Add only the stated chemical; the robot adds solvent.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #202a30

g.text: HTEL 48 × 2 mL holder | 42 vials: 37 receive chemicals, 5 start empty | A1 at the back-left

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #53636c
font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #53636c
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: GREEN / AMBER / BLUE: weigh the stated chemical(s). PURPLE: load an empty labelled vial. GREY: leave the position unused.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: SM = pyridine-2-sulfonyl fluoride. Product = 2-fluoropyridine (liquid; weigh by difference). Naphthalene is the internal standard.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: SM_FIT / P_FIT: calibration sources. SM_CHECK / P_CHECK: separate weighings for the LC accuracy check.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: HIGH / LOW / CHECK / IS_WORK / MATRIX: the robot makes these mixtures; staff add nothing to their empty vials.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Start on heater-shaker 10. Make/shake stocks there; move 10 → 1 after shaking. Keep the same vial positions and A1 orientation.
